profile.headline: Front & Back End - Experienced Software Engineer. UI/C#/JavaScript/Angular/T-SQL Developer.
profile.summary:
•	9+ years of experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer on large scale .NET Web applications (front-end, back-end, reporting, SQL programming, etcetera).

•	9+ Experience in building high-quality applications through Agile development methodologies, Test Driven Development and coding best practices.

•	11+ years of experience working in effective collaboration among local, geographically distributed and cross-functional team members

•	Technical Skills. Programming languages and frameworks: .NET Framework, ASP.NET, ASP.NET Core, .NET Core, C#, CSS 3, HTML 5, JavaScript, Java, jQuery, C#, Angular, TypeScript, SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), Transact-SQL (T-SQL), MSTest, NUnit, moq, Autofac, Web Services (WCF), Windows Services, Web APIs, FitNesse. IDEs: IntelliJ IDEA, Visual Studio 2015/2017/2019. DBMS: SQL Server. Versioning Control Systems: Git and TFS. Other technologies: Puppet and Terraform. Cloud Services: Azure. Others: Test-Driven Development (TDD), Object Oriented Programming (OOP), Design Patterns.
